items.title: Lillian Hardin Armstrong Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: Oliver came to the Dreamland to work. And I stayed at the Dreamland and worked with him.

ctx.x: I wondered about when you joined Oliver's band.

Oh, well, Eddie Garland, oh yeah, Eddie Garland, the boys, oh, Dewey went back to New Orleans. And anyway, the band broke up while we were at Dreamland. I don't know for what reason. The band broke up, but I stayed on as a pianist and every band came, I worked with them. So, a clarinet player, a violin player, I mean, Jimmy Corral? Walsh, I think he called him. Oh. Walsh had a band there after that and I stayed and played piano with them. And it was while I was at Dreamland that Oliver came to the gardens. And…
